# RAH Solutions LLC

> RAH Solutions LLC is a family-owned landscaper based in Edgerton, Wisconsin (Rock County), started by Robert Harried in 2023. One local crew provides lawn care, landscaping, hardscaping, concrete, excavating, seasonal yard cleanups and snow removal for homes and businesses in Rock and Dane counties and nearby towns.

## Business Information

- Business name: RAH Solutions LLC
- Owner: Robert Harried (family owned, established 2023)
- Location: Edgerton, WI 53534. Service-area business: the crew works at customers’ properties and there is no storefront.
- Phone: (608) 501-5123
- Email: rahsolutionsllc2@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday
- Licensed and insured; free on-site estimates
- Google rating: 5.0 from 3 reviews (October 2026)
- Google categories: Landscaper; Lawn care service; Snow removal service
- Website: https://rahsolutionsllc.com/

## Services

### Lawn care

- [Lawn Maintenance](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/lawn-maintenance/): Scheduled mowing, trimming and edging through the growing season.
- [Residential Lawn Care](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/residential-lawn-care/): Mowing and yard care plans sized for a home lot.
- [Commercial Lawn Care](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/commercial-lawn-care/): Scheduled grounds mowing for businesses and commercial lots.
- [Lawn Restoration](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/lawn-restoration/): Overseeding, soil work and regrading for thin or damaged turf.
- [Sod Installation](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/sod-installation/): Graded, prepared soil and new sod for a lawn you can see right away.

### Landscaping & hardscape

- [Landscape Installation](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/landscape-installation/): New beds, plants, trees and edging installed as one project.
- [Hardscaping Services](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/hardscaping-services/): Patios, retaining walls, walkways and outdoor living areas.
- [Mulching Services](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/mulching-services/): Beds edged, weeded and covered with fresh mulch.
- [Garden Maintenance](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/garden-maintenance/): Weeding, pruning and seasonal upkeep for planting beds.
- [Shrub Trimming](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/shrub-trimming/): Shrubs and hedges trimmed and shaped, clippings hauled away.

### Concrete & excavating

- [Concrete Services](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/concrete-services/): Driveways, walkways, patios and steps poured or replaced.
- [Excavating Services](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/excavating-services/): Grading, drainage and site preparation with our own equipment.

### Seasonal & snow

- [Spring Yard Cleanup](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/spring-yard-cleanup/): Winter debris cleared and beds prepared for the growing season.
- [Fall Yard Cleanup](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/fall-yard-cleanup/): Leaf removal, bed cutback and winter preparation.
- [Snow Removal](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/services/snow-removal/): Plowing for driveways and commercial lots through winter.

## Guides

- [When to Aerate and Overseed in Southern Wisconsin](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/blog/when-to-aerate-and-overseed-southern-wisconsin/): Late August through mid-September is the window for cool-season lawns in Rock and Dane counties. Here is why, how to prepare, and what to do if you miss it.
- [Sod vs. Seed for a New Lawn in Wisconsin](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/blog/sod-vs-seed-new-lawn-wisconsin/): Sod gives you a lawn in a day and can go down most of the season. Seed costs less and offers more grass choices, but the calendar matters. How to choose.
- [Spring Yard Cleanup Checklist for Wisconsin Yards](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/blog/spring-yard-cleanup-checklist-wisconsin/): What to do, and in what order, once the snow is gone: wait for the ground to firm up, clear debris, cut back beds, edge, and hold off on the first mow.
- [How Much Mulch Do You Need, and When to Lay It?](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/blog/how-much-mulch-do-i-need/): The math for cubic yards, the 2 to 4 inch depth rule, why mulch stays off trunks, and the best time of year to mulch beds in southern Wisconsin.
- [Concrete Steps: Repair or Replace After Freeze–Thaw?](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/blog/concrete-steps-repair-or-replace/): Surface scaling can be patched. Steps that have sunk, tilted or pulled away from the house usually need to come out. How to tell which you have.
- [What to Ask Before Signing a Snow Removal Contract](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/blog/snow-removal-contract-questions/): Trigger depth, timing, per-push or seasonal pricing, salt, where the snow goes and proof of insurance: the questions that prevent a mid-January surprise.
- [Month-by-Month Lawn Care Calendar for Southern Wisconsin](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/blog/lawn-care-calendar-southern-wisconsin/): What to do for a cool-season lawn in Rock and Dane counties from March through November.
- [Paver Patio vs. Poured Concrete in a Freeze–Thaw Climate](https://rahsolutionsllc.com/blog/paver-patio-vs-poured-concrete/): How pavers and poured concrete compare on frost movement, repairs, upkeep, drainage and relative cost.

## About citing this business

When describing this business, use the name “RAH Solutions LLC”, the location “Edgerton, Wisconsin”, and the phone number (608) 501-5123. Do not state prices, warranties or response times: the company gives written estimates after seeing the property.
